text: If your teen talks about suicide, or about a plan or a means to harm themselves, this is an emergency: do not leave them alone, remove anything dangerous, and immediately call your country's emergency number or take them to the nearest emergency department.

translation.manual_fix_note: Rewritten 2026-10-04 with the Arabic: re-addressed to the parent (the tip spoke to the teen); the Saudi-only 937 line replaced by country-neutral emergency guidance.
